types.name: Ringing phone box
types.note: Rings as you pass. A stranger gives one odd tip, or just breathes. Points to a hidden chest.

types.name: Snowman that moves
types.note: Look away and it has turned to you. Find the carrots: reward is a carrot-nose mask.

types.name: Bottle letter
types.note: A love story from 1962, one page per bottle. The last page leads to a buried box.

types.name: Door in the woods
types.note: Knock and something knocks back. At night it is ajar: out through another door.

types.name: Gnome on holiday
types.note: Carry it home to one garden. Rewards at 5, 10 and 20.

types.name: Echo spot
types.note: Shout; the echo answers with the wrong words. All echoes spell a password.

types.name: Grumpy claw machine
types.note: Cheats and insults you. One free try a day. Only place to win a plush Lykta.

types.name: Time capsule
types.note: Bury an item and a note for another player. Opens 24 December.

types.name: Frozen picnic
types.note: A full table, warm cocoa, nobody there. One set of footprints leads away.

types.name: Pigeon in a scarf
types.note: Follows whoever feeds it. Delivers one small gift between players.

types.name: Portal
types.note: Takes you somewhere: a place on the map, the open sky, or the Backrooms.

types.name: Runaway reindeer sleigh
types.note: Roaming event: it can turn up in different places. Pin where you would like it to happen.

types.name: Summit surprise
types.note: Roaming event: it can turn up in different places. Pin where you would like it to happen.

types.name: Ghost bus
types.note: Stops at an empty stop at night, doors open. Ride it and get off somewhere you did not choose.

types.name: Staircase to nowhere
types.note: Stairs standing alone in the woods. Climb to the top: something up there only shows from the last step.

types.name: Trampoline
types.note: Bounce higher each time. A very high bounce reaches things on roofs.

types.name: Sofa with a view
types.note: Sit down and watch the sky. Warms you up. Sometimes someone sits down next to you.

types.name: Goat on a roof
types.note: Will not come down. Find what it wants. Then it follows you for the day.

types.name: Buried car, radio still on
types.note: Only the aerial sticks out of the snow. The radio talks about you.

types.name: Accordion player
types.note: Plays alone in strange places. Stop to listen and the tune gets happier, or much slower.

types.name: Singing manhole
types.note: A tiny choir under the lid. Drop in gingerbread for an encore.

types.name: Birthday party for nobody
types.note: Candles lit, chairs pulled out, your name on the cake.

types.name: Runaway shopping trolley
types.note: Climb in at the top of a hill and hold on.

types.name: Waving scarecrow
types.note: Waves as you pass. The next field has one too. It looks like the same one.

types.name: Occupied outhouse
types.note: Knock and a voice says it is busy. Come back later: the door is open and warm.

types.name: Wishing well
types.note: One coin a day. Most wishes go slightly wrong.

types.name: Mailbox in the middle of nowhere
types.note: Post a note; an answer is waiting next day, in odd handwriting.

rules: GAME BUILD: use pin.pos (and dest.pos) when present, else pin.x/z. Run build/snap_mapideas.py before publishing so every pin has a pos (placed after the 28 Nov background fix, raw x/z are real but not yet moved off water/trees/buildings). pos.y is a hint: take the real ground height in game; pos.on = roof / bridge / ice is intentional. pin.x/z are the original clicks and are never changed. every marked spot goes in the game: pos.moved / pos.note say how far it had to move. pin.flag (should not happen) = ask Marius.
